svg.title: What to check when an external monitor is not detected: from cables to drivers
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
What to check when an external monitor is not detected:
from cables to drivers
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-05
Determine whether this is a first-time
connection or a previously working…
If this is the first time you are connecting the
monitor, press the Windows logo key + P and
first check whether “Extend” is selected.
Remove intermediate devices and
connect the cable directly
For example, suppose you connected a monitor
from a laptop through a USB-C hub but nothing
appears.
Press the Detect button in Settings
and check the graphics adapter
If the cable connection is correct, go to Start
> Settings > System > Display > Multiple
displays and select “Detect.” If the new display…
Check the driver if a previously
working setup has stopped
Microsoft recommends restarting the graphics
driver with Windows logo key + Ctrl + Shift + B
when an existing setup suddenly stops working.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
